en: My hunch is that Rosa is sick.
es: Para mí que Rosa está enferma.
why: After para mí que you lean one way, so the plain verb.

en: There is a chance that the bus won't come. (formal)
es: Cabe la posibilidad de que el bus no venga.
why: Cabe la posibilidad de que holds the idea open, so the subjunctive.

es: Para mí que Vale ya se fue.
why: A hunch takes the plain verb se fue.

en: There is a chance that the meeting will be moved. (formal)
es: Cabe la posibilidad de que la reunión se cambie.
why: Se cambie is subjunctive, which goes with cabe la posibilidad de que.

en: My hunch is that Don Hernando knows the truth.
es: Para mí que Don Hernando sabe la verdad.
why: A hunch leans, so the plain verb.

en: It is possible that the price will go up. (formal)
es: Cabe la posibilidad de que el precio suba.
why: The open idea after cabe la posibilidad de que takes the subjunctive.

en: My hunch is that it's going to rain.
es: Para mí que va a llover.
why: A casual hunch with a plain verb is para mí que.

en: There is a possibility that the café will close in March. (in a report)
es: Cabe la posibilidad de que el café cierre en marzo.
why: Cierre is subjunctive, so the formal frame.
